proposals.title: Fix the broken lint setup
proposals.body:
## Summary

Lint cannot start. `eslint.config.mjs` imports `eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals` and `eslint-config-next/typescript`, but the installed `eslint-config-next` is v15 while the app runs Next 16, and ESLint fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND before checking any file.

## Key Decisions

- Align `eslint-config-next` with the installed Next major version rather than rewriting the config by hand.

## Implementation

- Bump `eslint-config-next` in `package.json` to the version matching `next`.
- Confirm `npx eslint` runs on `app/` and `.devcontainer/codeyam-preview-origin.test.ts`, then fix any findings.
proposals.reason: Lint still cannot run, so no lint check guards the new race pages
notes: 2026-10-26: Seen again: running eslint on app/components/RaceThumb.tsx crashed with a module-resolution error before linting anything.
2026-10-27: Seen again 2026-10-27: ESLint failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals while linting the new devcontainer test.

proposals.title: Prototype plan resumes at Deconstruct with no app scaffolded
proposals.body:
## What happened
The completed prototype plan (source: prototype, step: 11) only contained HTML mockups. `editor step 11` failed with 'Cannot advance to step 11: no startCommand configured'. I had to ask the user for a stack and manually jump back with `editor step 4`, which printed a 'pointer moved BACKWARD' warning.

## What would have helped
When a prototype produced no app code, Finish and Formalize should start the plan at Prepare (scaffold) instead of Deconstruct, or step 11 should offer that route itself.
proposals.reason: A plan from a mockup-only prototype started at step 11 and failed: no startCommand

proposals.title: Relative seed token @today+Nh silently drops the hours
proposals.body:
## What happened
SCENARIO_FIXTURE_DATE_DRIFT told me to use `@today+2h`-style tokens. `@today+377h` expanded to `2026-11-11T00:00:00Z` (date-truncated), so a noon-ET deadline became 7 pm the previous evening and race days could shift a day in ET. No docs describe the difference between @now, @today and @date; I found it by checking the seeded API output and switched to `@now+Nh`.

## What would have helped
Document the three tokens' semantics in the audit note and register help, and warn when an hour/minute offset is combined with a date-truncating token.
proposals.reason: @today+377h expanded to a midnight date, shifting deadline times and race days

proposals.title: github-setup unusable in Codespaces because GITHUB_TOKEN shadows a real login
proposals.body:
## What happened
commit-state reported no-remote-gh-unauthed while `gh auth status` showed logged in via GITHUB_TOKEN. The push step only offered the manual github.com/new path. I had to run `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh auth login --web` in the shared terminal and then `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN codeyam-editor editor github-setup`. The user asked why it could not just sign in for them.

## What would have helped
In Codespaces, have github-setup drive the device-flow login itself (in the shared terminal) and ignore the codespace GITHUB_TOKEN for repo creation.
proposals.reason: gh looks signed in via the codespace token, which cannot create repos; needed env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh auth login

proposals.title: stage-feature --path replaces earlier staging, so the commit lost the app source
proposals.body:
## What happened
After the pre-commit lockfile check failed I ran `stage-feature --path .nvmrc --path README.md`. It reset the index to only those paths plus .codeyam/, listing the whole app as untouchedExternal, and the commit succeeded with no app code. I caught it from `git show --stat` and amended.

## What would have helped
Make stage-feature additive to what is already staged, or refuse to commit when untouchedExternal contains files the full-finalize marker validated.
proposals.reason: A second stage-feature --path call unstaged 68 app files; the commit went through without them

proposals.title: Scenario sandbox database emptied after a test run
proposals.body:
## What happened
After `refresh-tests --file …` the capture DB (.codeyam/tmp/db-sandbox/capture.db) had 0 rows, so the page rendered the empty state. `preview` with a scenarioSlug did not re-seed it; only `register` did. Also, the first register ran while the dev server was still down and saved a scenario whose seed never landed.

## What would have helped
Have `preview {scenarioSlug}` re-apply the seed when the sandbox is empty, and have register wait for the dev server before seeding.
proposals.reason: Preview rendered 0 races until the scenario was re-registered

proposals.title: Commit-step lint gate needs a file edit that the commit step forbids
proposals.body:
## What happened
The pre-commit hook blocked on lockfile-sync ('add a .nvmrc'), first reported only at Commit. Creating .nvmrc via shell worked, but editing README to match was refused because slug=commit allows no code changes.

## What would have helped
Run lockfile-sync in verify-build earlier (it skipped as 'no matching files' for untracked files), so the gap surfaces while edits are still allowed.
proposals.reason: lockfile-sync required .nvmrc at commit time; the matching README edit was then refused

proposals.title: Build agent "taking longer than usual" notice fires while the agent is mid-task
proposals.body:
## What happened

After the editor server reloaded (preview-origin-mode and later reload-config), the Build tab showed "The build agent is taking longer than usual — hasn't accepted its first instruction yet" while the one agent session (pty-broker list: one attached session) was busy mid-turn. The user saw it twice and asked to remove it. No CLI command dismisses it; the only options were reloading the tab or respawning the agent, which would have killed the work.

## What would have helped

Treat a reattached session that is mid-turn (activity: agent turn in flight) as accepted, or offer a dismiss command / close button that the agent can trigger.
proposals.reason: False alarm shown twice; the user asked to get rid of it

proposals.title: Blank-page check misses photos drawn as CSS backgrounds
proposals.body: ## What happened `client-errors` failed `racethumb-photo` with "Page rendered no visible content (no text, no images, no svg/canvas/video)". The component showed a photo through a CSS `background-image`, which the check does not count. I switched the app to an `` (fine here), but the check would block any legitimate background-image component. ## What would have helped Count elements with a non-empty computed `background-image` as visible content, or compare against a blank capture.
proposals.reason: A photo thumbnail was reported as a blank page

proposals.title: A malformed scenarioFixtureDateSkip entry breaks every editor command
proposals.body:
## What happened

The date-drift message says to add `{slug, table, field, reason}` to `audit.scenarioFixtureDateSkip`. I first added slug-only entries; afterwards every command (even command-status) failed with "cannot read .codeyam/editor.json: missing field `table`" and the advice that the editor may be older than the config. Nine scenarios needed 27 hand-written triples.

## What would have helped

An `audit-skip-dates --slug ... --reason fixed-reference-data` command that writes every flagged table/field, a whole-scenario skip form, and a parse error that names the bad entry instead of blaming the editor's version.
proposals.reason: A slug-only opt-out made the editor unable to read its own config

proposals.title: prove-red cannot measure a fix that lives in a shell script
proposals.body:
## What happened

`prove-red --neuter-file .devcontainer/codeyam-preview-origin.sh ...` with five named vitest tests ended BLOCKED: "its scope resolved to no files a configured runner owns". The named tests live in a .test.ts the vitest runner does own; only the neutered file was a .sh. I had to sed the script, run refresh-tests --file, git checkout, and record six prove-red-attest rows by hand.

## What would have helped

When --test names resolve to owned test files, route by those test files even if the neutered/--path files are outside every runner's sourceFilePatterns.
proposals.reason: Neutering a .sh fix reported selected-nothing; red had to be proven by hand and attested

proposals.title: Review gate refused to advance after the user answered until save-approval was run
proposals.body:
## What happened

At the Present (save) gate the user picked "Save my work — full check now" via the structured question. Running `fast-commit-stop` then `advance` as the step text instructs was refused with BLOCKED: no answer from the user is on record, naming `save-approval --answer`. The step body never mentions `save-approval`, so the approval had to be recorded on a second attempt.

## What would have helped

Either record the answer automatically from the question hook (as the audience question does), or list `save-approval --answer "<label>"` in the step's RUN THIS AFTERWARDS section next to `fast-commit-stop`.
proposals.reason: The step text never mentions save-approval; advance blocked right after a valid approval

proposals.title: preview-flow cannot scroll a below-the-fold element into view before capturing
proposals.body:
## What happened

To demo an opened Add to calendar menu on a race page, `preview-flow` clicked the menu trigger and captured, but the trigger sits near the bottom of the 1440x900 frame, so the opened menu was cut off. Adding a `#dates` anchor to the flow's path did not scroll the capture either. The workaround was a separate phone-width `preview-interact` capture copied into the demo folder by hand.

## What would have helped

A `scrollTo` step verb (selector or text) in `preview-flow`, or having `capture` scroll the last-interacted element into view, or honouring a URL fragment on navigate.
proposals.reason: A demo capture of an opened menu below the fold cut the menu off at the frame edge
